title: The Intra‐Industry Effects of Going‐Private Transactions

rival_explanations: arbitrager purchases of an industry portfolio in response to takeover rumors (not an external information effect)
incumbent managers possess more valuable inside information than outsiders (opposite prediction: MBO bids convey a larger signal via undiversified managerial ownership, Leland-Pyle)

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (going-private target firms and their horizontal industry rivals spanning 37 two-digit SIC codes; excludes conglomerates, utilities, and financial firms)
context.sample_size: 128 going-private bid announcements (78 by incumbent management, 50 by outsiders)
